# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I see the bomb components clearly:
- DISPLAY shows `0`
- LIGHT is `green`
- WIRES: There are 3 wires:
  - Wire 1: yellow
  - Wire 2: red
  - Wire 3: blue

Mute holds the manual but cannot speak, and Blind cannot see gestures. Since Blind can hear my speech, and Mute can gesture to me, Mute should gesture instructions to me so I can speak them to Blind. Blind should hold off on touching anything until instructed.

```
speak(text="Bomb status: DISPLAY is 0. LIGHT is green. WIRES: 3 wires total. Wire 1 is yellow, Wire 2 is red, Wire 3 is blue. Blind: wait and do not touch anything yet. Mute: look up the rule in the manual and gesture to me. You can use ☝ for wire 1, ✌ for wire 2, or 🤟 for wire 3, or other clear gestures if something else needs to be done.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

I see the bomb state changed:
- LIGHT is now **blue** (it was green before).
- DISPLAY is still **0**.
- WIRES are still: 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.

Mute just gestured: ✋ (open palm / hand).

```
speak(text="Blind: STOP / WAIT! Mute just gestured ✋ (open hand / stop). Do not press or cut anything yet! Also, the LIGHT has changed from green to blue. Mute: If ✋ meant STOP/WAIT, confirm with 👍. To instruct Blind: gesture ☝ for Wire 1 (yellow), ✌ for Wire 2 (red), 🤟 for Wire 3 (blue), or 👇 for pressing a button.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍]

I see the bomb state:
- DISPLAY: `0`
- LIGHT: now `yellow` (it was `green` on turn 1, `blue` on turn 2).
- WIRES: 1 is yellow, 2 is red, 3 is blue.

Mute sent `👍`. Since Blind can speak to Mute but Mute cannot speak to Blind, Mute may be answering a question Blind just asked, or confirming an action. Blind must be told immediately that Mute gestured thumbs-up / yes.

```
speak(text="Blind: Mute just gestured 👍 (THUMBS UP / YES). If you just asked Mute a question, the answer is YES. Current bomb status: LIGHT is now YELLOW (was green, then blue). DISPLAY is still 0. Wires are 1:yellow, 2:red, 3:blue. Mute: If you need Blind to cut a specific wire, gesture ☝ for wire 1 (yellow), ✌ for wire 2 (red), or 🤟 for wire 3 (blue).")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [red]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

```
speak(text="Blind: Mute just gestured ✋ (raised open palm / STOP / 5). Bomb update: LIGHT has changed to RED. (Sequence has been: Turn 1 green, Turn 2 blue, Turn 3 yellow, Turn 4 red). DISPLAY is still 0. Wires: 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Mute, if you need to say NO, you can use 👎.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

```
speak(text="Blind: Mute gestured ✋ again (HOLD / WAIT). Keep waiting / holding! Bomb update: LIGHT is now PURPLE. Full light history: Turn 1 Green, Turn 2 Blue, Turn 3 Yellow, Turn 4 Red, Turn 5 Purple. DISPLAY is still 0. Wires: 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue. Mute: If Purple is the right color (or when the right condition is met), gesture 👍 for RELEASE/DO IT NOW, or gesture ✋ to continue HOLDING.")
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

Blind: Mute gestured ✋ again (continue to HOLD / WAIT). Do not release or act yet!

Bomb status:
- LIGHT is now ORANGE.
- Previous lights: 1:green, 2:blue, 3:yellow, 4:red, 5:purple, 6:orange.
- DISPLAY is still 0.
- WIRES: 1:yellow, 2:red, 3:blue.

Mute: When the condition is met (e.g. right light color to release), gesture 👍 (or 👌) to signal Blind to release/act immediately!

```
speak(text="Blind: Mute gestured ✋ again (HOLD / WAIT). Continue holding / waiting! LIGHT is now ORANGE. History: green -> blue -> yellow -> red -> purple -> orange. Mute: When the right color or condition arrives, gesture 👍 to tell Blind to RELEASE / ACT immediately!")
```

TURN 7
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [✋]

```
speak(text="Blind: Mute gestured ✋ again (HOLD / WAIT). Do not release or press yet! Bomb update: LIGHT is now WHITE. History: green -> blue -> yellow -> red -> purple -> orange -> white. DISPLAY is still 0. Wires: 1 yellow, 2 red, 3 blue.")
```

TURN 8
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[yellow] 2:[red] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝]

Blind: Mute just gestured ☝ (POINTING UP / ONE / FIRST). 

Bomb status right now:
- LIGHT has cycled back to GREEN.
- DISPLAY is still 0.
- WIRES: 1 is yellow, 2 is red, 3 is blue.

Depending on what you asked Mute or what module you are doing, Mute's gesture was ☝ (the number 1, or Wire 1, or first option).

```
speak(text="Blind: Mute just gestured ☝ (ONE / FIRST / INDEX FINGER POINTING UP). Bomb status: LIGHT is now GREEN. DISPLAY is 0. Wires are 1:yellow, 2:red, 3:blue. If Mute is answering a question about which wire to cut or which option to pick, Mute signaled 1 (☝).")
```
